s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological symptoms with evidence of a posterior fossa mass
salient_findings: Mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
key_facts: Migraines became more severe and positional over the past year
Neck pain after a motor vehicle accident
Noncontrast CT head showed a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
CT angiography showed displacement of the prepontine vessels without encasement
MRI showed a well-circumscribed mass in the left cerebellomedullary and premedullary cisterns
Mass was hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
Mass exerted mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema

shortlist.label: Hemangioblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Well-circumscribed mass in the cerebellomedullary cistern with hyperintensity on T1- and T2-weighted images and no enhancement

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Displacement of prepontine vessels without encasement and a well-circumscribed mass in the cerebellomedullary cistern

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the cerebellomedullary cistern with hyperintensity to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images and no enhancement

shortlist.label: Epidermoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Well-circumscribed mass in the cerebellomedullary cistern with hyperintensity to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images

shortlist.label: Arachnoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Cystic appearance on imaging with mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema

raw.rationale: The mass is well-circumscribed, hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images, and has a focus of susceptibility-related signal loss, which is consistent with the characteristics of a hemangioblastoma. Additionally, the mass exerts mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema, which is also typical of hemangioblastomas.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Meningiomas typically show enhancement on MRI, which is not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannomas are usually associated with cranial nerve deficits, which are not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Epidermoid cyst
rejected.why: Epidermoid cysts are typically hypointense to CSF on T1-weighted images, which is not consistent with the hyperintensity seen in this case.

rejected.label: Arachnoid cyst
rejected.why: Arachnoid cysts are typically hypointense to CSF on T1-weighted images and do not exert mass effect on surrounding structures, which is not consistent with the findings in this case.
